rows.text: You reach an Elway-style tavern with a lively atmosphere.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: You order a cocktail concocted with Marian oranges and palm cinnamon. Then, you observe the crowd. Everyone is wearing a mask and has different body sizes. From this, you know it is a tavern where the Masked Fools gather.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "Welcome to Tavern World's End." Bragi, the bartender, bows deeply to the patrons and continues, "We only serve customers with a sense of humor."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "In keeping with Aha's will, we will have some fun next. Mr. France and his team of bodyguards will be the next to join the arena. His opponent will be Avila. He and his mercenaries are burly and not to be underestimated!"
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "Who else is coming? Who's up for the 78,201st round?"
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe
